items.title: Could being bored save your creative career?

My wife, Kate, knows me really well, and freed up my long weekend so I could mooch around as I pleased. I went for long walks by myself, we went for short walks together, we ate, danced, cuddled on the sofa a little with our son . . . you know, the good stuff.
